user.description: This integration emulates (and replaces) the physical Nilan CTS600 control panel.

data_description.name: Identify the ventilation unit controlled by Nilan CTS600.
data_description.port: The serial RS485 adapter wired to Nilan CTS600.
data_description.sensor_T15: An entity that provides the room temperature. This emulates the temperature sensor in the control panel.
data_description.retries: Number of times to retry RS485 communications with CTS600 before giving up.
